This AI Agent and Automation built on n8n helps the user make 3 variants of creatives from just a single white background image. 

The AI agent node on n8n is trained in Sales Psychology and provides all the details and prompts on what the copy and visual should look like.

And then the image generation nodes on n8n cater to the final output... Making beautiful post-worthy creatives! 

This was inspired by one of the workflows made by Yashica AI on her YouTube channel which I tweaked to be sales psychology trained and provide creatives ready for ads testing.

node.text:
On 29th October, 2025.... We took one step closer to Making India AI Ready, when I got the opportunity to share my knowledge and understanding on the subject matter with our Youth - our Next Generation of Builders!! 

We got an audience of over 150 students who were not just curious about the subject matter... But sooo hungry that some even came traveling from 105+ Kms away and over 4 hours!! 🔥🙌

The Myth is.... That college students do not attend lectures and do not study in classes. The Reality.... Even shocked me... When even after 4.5 hours of a rigorous continuous class... They all were still excited and still hungry for more!!❤️

Who knew that a No-Code Automation Software, n8n, and the opportunity to learn the real life implementations of Artificial Intelligence could spark such a fire inside these Young Minds!!🔥

It was a delight to put in my small contribution in the enablement of an AI Ready India. When my throat dried up after 3 hours of continuous delivery... The things that kept me going were my love and understanding of the responsibility of the stage... And the zeel in the eyes of these young ones to end the day by becoming a better version of themselves!❤️

Thank you so much @cst.mait for giving me this chance to be a part of something greater than myself! And thank you to all the Department Fuculties and Event Coordinators for being such a wonderful host! Special shoutout to Rishabh and Niyati for making all this happen! 

And lastly... Thank you all for being such a wonderful audience for my first stage delivery after so long! Quote: Do it for the Love of Stage, Not for the Love of Fame!✨ And to God be the Glory!❤️

#publicspeaking #aiworkshop #n8n #tedx
